name: ch9_selected_shunt_gw006
title: ch9_selected with a slower shunt integrator (shunt_int_g_w 0.03 -> 0.06)
description: Identical to ch9_selected (399e30d3b60b) in every controller weight; only
The integrator advances by g_H / (2 shunt_int_g_w) per TS iteration and
commits at q/2 + delta = 22.5 Mvar from the committed level, so the time to
a commit under constant boundary pressure is
At the reference p90 pressure |g_H| = 0.133 and T_TS = 180 s this moves the
commit persistence from 30 min (the 2026-09-11 derivation) to 61 min.
Zero-mean fluctuations of g_H are integrated with half the step, so their
contribution to commits falls further (about with shunt_int_g_w^2 for white
fluctuations; hypothesis, the loop-filtered noise is not white).
Purpose: reduce MSC/MSR switching. At ch9_selected the Stage-II bank
recorded 210 commits and 144 reversals within 2 h over 6 x 12 h.
NOT a re-selection: the Chapter-9 selection rule did not see shunt wear,
and this variant was not passed through it.

provenance.validation_run: results/THESIS_shunt_gw_compare_20261014 (W4, W5 evented 12 h, DSO_3 x2; make_config scenario 6 h)
